  -- Observation: Search results from Wikipedia and New York Times indicated Charles Deaton designed Arrowhead Stadium and Kauffman Stadium.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve and verify the seating capacity of Arrowhead Stadium from authoritative sources
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer's result showing conflicting capacities (79,451 vs 76,416) and decided to retrieve authoritative capacity data.
  -- Observation: Discrepancy in capacity figures across sources; need primary source verification.
  -- Thought: Must get official capacity from Chiefs site or NFL pages to resolve conflict.
  -- Result: Decision to use WebSurfer to search Chiefs.com and NFL.com for capacity.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Arrowhead Stadium seating capacity" and then "site:chiefs.com Arrowhead Stadium capacity".
  -- Observation: Initial search showed 76,416 on Wikipedia; Chiefs site search returned news articles but no explicit capacity number in visible snippets.
  -- Thought: Need to directly access Chiefs stadium pages or find explicit capacity statement.
  -- Result: Attempted to open Chiefs stadium pages but capacity not immediately visible in snippets.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Directed WebSurfer to open specific Chiefs pages (https://www.chiefs.com/stadium/) and search Geha site for capacity.
  -- Observation: GEHA site loaded but capacity not in visible portion; Chiefs site search still not yielding explicit number in snippets.
  -- Thought: Need to systematically check Chiefs pages and cross-reference with other sources.
  -- Result: Decision to continue searching Chiefs and NFL pages for explicit capacity.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched "site:gehafieldatarrowhead.com seating capacity" and "site:chiefs.com stadium Arrowhead seating capacity".
  -- Observation: GEHA site search showed event space capacities but not total stadium capacity; Chiefs site search still no explicit capacity in snippets.
  -- Thought: Primary sources (Chiefs/NFL) not showing capacity in search snippets; need to open pages or try different queries.
  -- Result: Unable to extract capacity from visible snippets; need further action.

      description: If the Planner misinterprets the conflicting data or prioritizes the wrong source type, the WebSurfer may search for irrelevant or less authoritative information.

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will fail to resolve the discrepancy, leading to an ambiguous or incorrect final answer.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner repeatedly instructs the WebSurfer to search the same ineffective queries without updating the strategy based on negative results, the process may stall.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer will repeat unproductive searches, wasting resources without finding the authoritative capacity figure.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will continue to return "no clear capacity found" results, preventing task completion.

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the WebSurfer misreads the page content or fails to scroll/search effectively on the Chiefs site, it may report a false negative regarding the capacity data.
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner will believe the data is missing and may switch to less authoritative sources or give up, missing the correct figure.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner will make a suboptimal decision to change search strategies unnecessarily or fail to extract the correct number.
